## Bug fixes

- The mini radio sizes itself again on PCs where Edge captions its floating window with the page's file path; it used to open at the browser's size and ask you to click.
- The mini radio's size watcher no longer stops if it glances at the radio window while the strip is still opening, which also left the strip asking you to click.
- Fixes in seasonal themes.
